# tools/fern-goldens/generate-fern-fixture.sh. Not listed here: `pydantic_config.enum_type:

# tests/fixtures/AGENTS.md); a fixture cannot opt out of it from this table. Its
# `--enum-type literals` mode leaves it unset for `expected-literals/` instead.
